en: ...All right!
Good morning, Aniki.
Hey. Didn't notice you were back.
Yeah, sorry I was late.
Well, as to what we gotta do today...
Yeah, I think it's gonna be hairy.
If you need to do anything first, better go do it right now.
I'll do the same. Let's meet back here by noon.
(This could be the last day to roam free in Tsukimino.)
(Better not leave with any regrets.)
(He said to rest up, but do I really wanna?)
I can sleep when I'm dead.
It <Italic>is</Italic> gonna be a busy day tomorrow...
It took you a while to come back.
I was doin' recon at the site. Security is everywhere. It's gonna be tough to even get close.
That's the least of our worries.
Even if we manage to pull off this abduction, we're gonna have both the cops and the Kitakata chasing us.
Our chances of success are... pretty damn slim.
Yeah, tell me somethin' I don't know. We're still gonna try, and any problems that arise, we'll deal with 'em as they come.
I gotta know the truth behind Majima's death. Whatever it takes, I gotta know.
For what?
For gettin' ya involved.
Aniki, you saved my life in prison, and on the mountain!
It's my turn to do something for you. Please don't apologize for receiving what you're owed.
All right. 'Preciate it.
So... Did you find anything we can use for the actual kidnapping itself?
That's the thing. I got no idea how we're gonna get close to Kitakata.
Gotta figure out some way of gettin' close without bein' noticed.
You know, I... I just remembered something. I have to go out for a bit.
Nothing important. You should probably get some shut-eye while I'm gone.
(What's eatin' Baba-chan?)
(Do I really wanna sleep like he suggested?)
Hey. How're ya doin'?
Much better than yesterday. I'll be able to put in a proper day's work today!
Okay. But we can't go out together⑬that'll draw attention. We'll do the scoutin' separately.
Good idea. Let's meet back here when we're both done casing the site.
So did you learn anything useful?
Yeah. Kitakata's gonna be a guest of honor at the snow festival's opening ceremony. That's two days from now, at noon.
That makes sense. He's a local VIP in this town.
Yeah. Which means we don't know when his path is gonna cross ours again... This ceremony is the only chance we'll get.
Waitin' around for another opportunity will just get us nabbed by cops.
But how are we going to get Kitakata to talk to us?
And won't he be center stage at the snow festival? That's not exactly ideal.
There'll be lotsa security, that's true.
Um, then maybe... What if we disguised ourselves as guests?
With my build? Won't ever work.
Okay. We could... wait until the end of the ceremony, after he walks offstage, and approach him then?
I'll get collared long before that.
Well, then, uh...
That settles it. We'll have to kidnap him.
It's our only choice.
We can do it during the ceremony if we choose a moment when there's hardly any guards around 'im.
Wait! Just listen to what you're saying!
This isn't just some little block party.
There'll be tens, no, hundreds of thousands of people watching the ceremony on TV.
There's no way we can pull off a kidnapping!
It's still the only way.
Every day we do nothin' is a day where I might get hauled back to prison. Can't have that.
No choice. We gotta make a move. We'll nab him when no one's payin' attention.
And when would that be?
Well, obviously we gotta plan it out.
The only thing harder than this would be if we just outright attacked their office!
Oh come on... It's not like the boss is some spring chicken. How hard could it be to snatch 'im?
It just seems so impossible.
Y'know, why is Kitakata so popular around town anyway?
Well, he's third generation. The family's ruled Tsukimino since before the war.
He's got deep ties in the local community. Nobody has a reason to speak ill of him.
In fact, when a gang from Tohoku tried to muscle their way in, the Kitakata protected the whole town.
Huh. Sounds like a man after my own heart.
Which is why I can't believe he'd just kill Majima-san for no reason.
Could be... if he's as responsible a man as he sounds...
He mighta been resistin' something that woulda been bad for his family. There's a rumor that Majima tried to force Kitakata to kneel to the Tojo Clan.
Even if that rumor's true, the boss I knew would have used reason before violence. I'm sure of it.
He's not some psychopath.
Well, we'll hear the truth when we meet the man.
We gotta sneak into the festival ceremony somehow.
Then we should check out the site tomorrow, during the daytime.
I've got cash. Take some.
This from an old connection in town?
You could say that. There's no telling what might happen, so...
That's true. 'Preciate it.
It's pretty crazy, right?
We should be out on parole right now, but instead we're runaways, drinking at a place like this, jumpy as rats...
Hey, I was lookin' forward to havin' a drink with you anyway. So this ain't so bad.
Why do you think they put out a warrant for you and not for me?
They just made me into an anonymous dead body. They didn't even broadcast my name!
What the hell does that mean?
(No idea, kid...)
Is the Tojo Clan behind all of this? Behind this manhunt and what happened in prison...?
Oh, guess you don't want to think about that...
Just gonna go take care of some things.
Huh? You're not afraid of being recognized?
Can't live life in fear. And I've got stuff to do.
But it's teeming with cops out there!
I'm used to it. Dealt with the same thing two years ago.
What's so important? Are you going to try and get intel on the Kitakata Family?
Kinda necessary, doncha think? If we wanna find their boss.
Well, in that case, you'll want to try a joint called Ambitious.
Kitakata guys used to hang there. They probably still do.
Ambitious, ya said?
Yeah, the family runs a casino in the back room. It's been there for years.
If you tip the bartender, he'll take you to the casino.
And then it'll just be a simple thing to get the down low, right? Heh.
So simple. But on a serious note... please be careful.
The Kitakata Family is old school. If they decide you're an enemy, they don't hold back.
They're a bunch of hardliners not afraid to die for the old man.
All the more fun.
At least take this with you.
A phone?
I got it through an old connection. It's prepaid, and untraceable.
It's right up here.
Ya got the time?
It's already past noon. The opening ceremony should've started by now.
All right, here we are.
Somethin' the matter? You're not gettin' cold feet on me now, are ya?
No! It's just... I don't know what to say to the boss when I see him...
Don't be worryin' about that now. Focus on how we're gonna pull off the kidnappin'.
...You're right, Aniki. I'm sorry.
All right. Let's go.
I bought this building just the other day.
Tsukimino's been hurting economically.
Speculators come crying to me with properties they can't sell.
Hmph. It's not like I'm rolling in dough either.
Let's cut to the chase. What did ya wanna tell me?
Somethin' to do with Majima's final words?
Yeah. Something like that.
Um, I'm going to scout the area. Saejima-aniki and I can't just take your word that it's safe.
Heh, that kid wasn't born yesterday. He another sworn brother of yours?
...Thought you two might know each other, actually.
No, can't say we do.
You know, you're not like how I thought you'd be.
I was expecting more of a big, strong brute.
But I should have figured... You're a sworn brother of Majima, and like him, you're soft on the inside.
First time I been called that.
Hmph. Our line of work has been taken over by those too blind to see the forest for the trees.
All they care about is posturing. Pretending to be the tough guy. That's why they fail.
...By the way. You don't seem all too angry for someone whose sworn brother was murdered.
If he's dead, it means he was weak.
Ain't no call for me to get involved just 'cause the weak fell to the strong.
But I do wanna know... <Italic>Why</Italic> did Majima hafta be killed?
And what were his dyin' words? That much, I gotta hear.
So when are ya gonna quit stallin' and tell me?
Well... I've been turning it all over in my mind...
How to tell you what happened that day. How to tell you the truth.
What truth?
Let's hear it.
...The Kitakata Family didn't kill Majima.
We never had any reason to...
I mean exactly what I say. Nothing more, nothing less.
I know Majima tried to make ya accept an allegiance pact with the Tojo Clan.
That's more than enough reason to snuff him out.
Don't try to tell me ya had no motivation.
Ah, but that's where you're mistaken. Majima never demanded that we become a subsidiary of the Tojo.
He came with his head bowed, asking me to accept an equal alliance.
In other words, he asked me to become Daigo Dojima's sworn brother.
Kitakata and Tojo... Equal partners?
Oh yes. And not just us. Apparently, the same deal was being offered in Fukuoka and Nagoya.
(...What's goin' on?)
I did not, and still don't, have any objections to an equal partnership.
With Tojo as a partner, people will think twice before trying to mess with us.
So you were gonna accept the pact?
I was. So you can see, I had no reason to kill Majima.
Then who did?
That's... the most important truth I have to tell you.
After the first meeting, I ruminated on the excellent offer, made my decision, and arranged for a second talk with Majima.
That's when things went sideways.
I told Majima I would take the offer, but then he just sat there in complete silence.
Yeah. And when he finally did open his mouth, I couldn't believe what he said.
What was it?
He said in a very serious tone... that I shouldn't accept the alliance.
What!? That doesn't make any sense!
So... you took on a passenger from the middle of the line today, right? <Color:7>Tenjin Transportation<Color:Default> came bellyachin' about it.
We get enough flak from the other firms as it is. Mind bein' a bit more careful?
Sorry for the trouble, sir. It was an amateur mistake.
Ah, don't be so hard on yerself. I'm about to head over there with some cakes or what have ya and apologize.
No. I should be the one to go.
Like heck ya should. It's my company, so I've gotta do this.
Please, I insist.
Yeah? Guess I'll leave it in yer hands, then.
You know where Tenjin Transportation is, right? Over on West Gion Street.
Well, hope everythin' goes well. Call me after you're done there.
(I need to go to Tenjin Transportation and apologize. That should set things right.)
Sorry I had to do this, but I gotta know the facts about my sworn brother.
(And only Kitakata himself knows those facts.)
Ugh, fuck you...
(He doesn't know when to quit...)
Don't think this is over. We'll hunt you down.
You can't escape the Kitakata in Tsukimino.
(Great. Now they'll be tailin' me.)
I'm sorry sir, this area is closed to the public.
Hey, take a look at this pass I got here.
Hm, show the barkeep, please.
Please go on through.
Only two days left 'til the snow festival. Nothing quite like knockin' back a few drinks to keep warm in that bitin' cold.
I hear there are gonna be lots of people there this year, too.
That's good! With all the sponsors ditchin' over the past few years, I was afraid the festival was gonna flat out disappear or some shit.
They say the big crowds this year are all because of the old man.
Patriarch Kitakata?
Yeah. Apparently he scared up sponsors all across Hokkaido, and didn't let up until the festival was fully funded.
Hell yeah. That's our guy.
(Just need them to say where he is...)
The boss has got more connections than I can count. Shit, he's even had drinks with the mayor.
Really? The mayor of Sapporo?
Yeah. Trust me, I was there, man.
The mayor, he treated Kitakata with total respect. It was something to behold. Glad I'm in this family, let me tell ya!
Well, the mayor <Italic>should</Italic> have some respect. This festival wouldn't even be happening without the old man.
Also explains why he's a guest of honor.
(Now there's some useful info.)
You didn't know?
Kitakata's going to be in the festival's opening ceremony with all the other guests in front of the special stage.
Heh, thank goodness it starts at noon. He hates getting up early.
Tch, he also hates stuffed-shirt events. Won't this be torture for him?
For some reason, he cheerfully accepted this particular invite.
